meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 这个技能会安装 OneCLI 工具，配置 Agent Vault 网关，并把项目 .env 文件里的凭据（如 Anthropic 密钥）迁移进保管库。之后代理在请求时自动获取密钥，原始密钥不再留在 .env 中，网关层统一注入。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 作为破坏性更改之后，或首次进行 OneCLI 设置时触发。

say.note: 开始安装并配置，之后可迁移凭据

say.text: 把 .env 里的凭据迁到 OneCLI 保管库
say.note: 会扫描常见密钥并迁移，然后从 .env 移除

say.text: 重新配置 OneCLI 并迁移凭据
say.note: 若已有配置会先询问是否重新开始

howto.what_en: This skill installs the OneCLI tool, configures the Agent Vault gateway, and migrates credentials (e.g., Anthropic keys) from the project's .env file into the vault. After that, agents get credentials injected automatically at the gateway; raw keys are no longer kept in .env.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or when OneCLI is set up for the first time.

say_en.text: Migrate credentials from .env to the OneCLI vault
say_en.note: Scans and migrates common keys, then removes them from .env.
Asks whether to start fresh if configured already.
